pages.title: Omnipotent Edge
pages.text: A blade with no thickness and no limit. What it cuts has never existed.

Cuts through any armour and any invulnerability. Use: $(thing)Erasure$() - hostile creatures in a cone before you cease to exist. Sneak-use: $(thing)Chronal Stasis$() - time stops for every creature within 24 blocks for 10 seconds.
